plugins.name: easedup
plugins.description: K-12 education assistant for creating curriculum-aligned teaching resources including lesson plans, units of work, assessments, and more

skills.name: curriculum-alignment
skills.description: Search and reference curriculum standards using EasedUP MCP tools — applies when creating resources that require curriculum content descriptions or achievement standards
skills.description_zh: 通过EasedUP MCP搜索并引用课程标准，为教育资源提供内容描述与成就标准。

skills.name: resource-creation
skills.description: Guidelines for creating K-12 educational resources — applies when teachers request lesson plans, units of work, activities, assessments, presentations, handouts, or factsheets
skills.description_zh: 指导创建K至12年级教案、教学单元、活动、评估、演示、讲义与事实资料。

skills.name: teaching-strategies
skills.description: Teaching strategy selection and learning mode guidance for K-12 resource development — applies when designing lessons, units, or activities
skills.description_zh: 为K至12年级课程、单元与活动选择教学策略和学习模式。

commands.name: create-activity
commands.description: Create a hands-on learning activity for K-12 students. Usage: /easedup:create-activity [activity type, topic, year level]

commands.name: create-assessment
commands.description: Create a formative or summative assessment with rubric. Usage: /easedup:create-assessment [topic, subject, year level, formative/summative]

commands.name: create-factsheet
commands.description: Create a concise student factsheet covering key concepts. Usage: /easedup:create-factsheet [topic, subject, year level]

commands.name: create-handout
commands.description: Create a student handout or worksheet. Usage: /easedup:create-handout [topic, subject, year level, purpose]

commands.name: create-lesson
commands.description: Create a curriculum-aligned lesson plan. Usage: /easedup:create-lesson [topic, subject, year level]

commands.name: create-presentation
commands.description: Create a classroom teaching presentation with slides. Usage: /easedup:create-presentation [topic, subject, year level, number of slides]

commands.name: create-unit
commands.description: Create a unit of work spanning multiple lessons. Usage: /easedup:create-unit [topic, subject, year level, duration]

commands.name: search-curriculum
commands.description: Search curriculum standards from EasedUP (Australian Curriculum v9, Common Core, UK National Curriculum). Usage: /easedup:search-curriculum [topic, year level, curriculum]

name: easedup
summary_zh: 提供K-12 教育助理，用于创建与课程一致的教学资源，包括课程计划、工作单元、评估等。
